newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power lifts shoulder hour prices $1/MWh.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power lifts shoulder hour prices $1/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration left peak and off-peak next-day offer prices unchanged, but did raise some shoulder hour prices by $1.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the federal agency said Thursday.
Shoulder hour prices were split between $17.00 for hours ending 0600 and 2400 ($16.00 non-firm) and $18.00 for hours ending 0700, 2200 and 2300 ($17.00 non-firm).
Prices for peak-hour sales between 0800 and 2100 PDT were unchanged at $20.00 per MWh ($19.00 non-firm). Off-peak prices were also unchanged at $15.00 ($14.00 off-peak).
In addition, no volume limits were placed on Friday pre-schedulings.
